theorems.name: Submission.polyhedral_approx_measure_uniqueness
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (μ₁ μ₂ : Measure (Eucl P)) (g₁ g₂ : Eucl P → ℝ), (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn g₁ K μ₁ ∧ IntegrableOn g₂ K μ₂) → (∀ ψ : Eucl P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ U → ∫ x, ψ x * g₁ x ∂μ₁ = ∫ x, ψ x * g₂ x ∂μ₂) → ∀ A : Set (Eucl P), MeasurableSet A → ∀ u : Eucl P → ℝ, Continuous u → HasCompactSupport u → tsupport u ⊆ U → ∫ x in A, u x * g₁ x ∂μ₁ = ∫ x in A, u x * g₂ x ∂μ₂
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
